= Third-party dependencies

This page lists the third-party dependencies used to build {n}.
The authoritative, version-pinned source is the `go.mod` module file; this
page mirrors its direct requirements (runtime and tooling). The full
indirect graph is reproducible via `go list -m all` and intentionally not
duplicated here.

the main module so that CI and contributors share pinned versions.
